digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, completion verifier, attestation validation
propositions: [operator-attested] tag on code-verifiable acceptance criteria (with exact repository path/symbol evidence) bypasses plan-review guards and reaches the completion verifier at close time, enabling attestation laundering.

Evidence-kind criterion fires non-deterministically on tagged repository-provable ACs; det_measurement_provenance correctly detects missing provenance lines but surfaces only as advisory (P6), allowing tagged ACs lacking provenance to pass review and close.

A deterministic pre-close guard is required (fail-closed, blocking-posture, before LLM evaluation) to reject mistagged code-verifiable ACs or those missing provenance continuation lines, since the completion verifier trusts tags by design (ADR-0043).

The fix detects laundering via new det_attestation_launder.py detector (repo-path/symbol matchers: src/tests/docs/scripts/ prefixes, slash paths with code extensions, pytest ::node ids, bare test_* symbols) and blocks at close via txn.ensure_attested_items_valid precheck, offering untag/split remedies.

Legitimate external ACs (deploy/vote/console evidence with provenance lines and Gerrit/GitHub Actions attestation) must remain unblocked; mixed-evidence ACs (test + external outcome) fire and coach split into separate tagged/untagged criteria.

Retags stale the signed plan-review attestation and require re-review; tag normalization out of the fingerprint is deferred pending a direction-sensitive exemption design (tag-REMOVE + provenance-ADD safe; tag-ADD always material).
